free_tier.stated: No free plan. A 3-day free trial with 'No credit card required' is limited to 1,000 users each month ('688/1000 claimed this month' when read) and gives 1 simultaneous connection. The 1-year plan is listed at '$39.99 billed annually' (struck-through $119.88), with 3 simultaneous connections, 172 locations and unlimited data transfer; the 2-year plan with 6 months free is $55.99 and the 1-month plan is $9.99.
free_tier.notes: The trial is 3 days and capped at 1,000 users a month; the unit vocabulary has no days term, so mixed is used. The page was read during a Black Friday sale banner ('+ 6 Months FREE'), so the listed prices may be sale prices.

retention.stated: not applicable: a tunnel, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Unlimited: the vendor states 'unlimited data transfer and unlimited bandwidth on all paid plans', and its FAQ says the service 'doesn't block or throttle any kind of internet traffic'. The trial is also stated as unlimited data.
egress.free_allowance: trial: 3 days, 1 simultaneous connection, no card

interface_detail: A tunnel and a proxy. Protocols listed on the manual setup page: WireGuard, Amnezia VPN, AmneziaWG, OpenVPN, L2TP/IPSec, IKEv2, PPTP, SSTP, a SOCKS5 proxy and ShadowSocks; plus apps and browser extensions. UDP: the vendor's SOCKS5 post says its SOCKS5 proxy servers can use UDP. Port forwarding: yes, one port from 5000 to 65535, only together with a paid Dedicated IP. SOCKS5: yes, 'all Trust.Zone VPN servers support SOCKS5 proxy' (vpn.trust.zone). Obfuscation: ShadowSocks and AmneziaWG are offered; the pages read give no detail of either. BitTorrent: not blocked ('All kinds of internet traffic are allowed').
tooling: The vendor's Windows client and browser extensions, or any WireGuard, OpenVPN, L2TP/IPSec, IKEv2, SSTP, ShadowSocks or SOCKS5 client with the credentials and config files shown after login; the manual setup page hides the username, password and config files behind a login.
chaining: A tunnel or SOCKS5 exit: a job can connect over a tunnel or send traffic to the SOCKS5 proxy at vpn.trust.zone, and the upstream sees a shared VPN address, or a dedicated address when the paid Dedicated IP add-on is bought.

limits.value: shared exit addresses on the plans; a dedicated static IP is a paid add-on and is required for port forwarding
3 simultaneous connections on the 1-year plan and 1-month plan, 5 on the 2-year plan, 1 on the trial

limits_note: The simultaneous-connection count is filed under request-rate because the vocabulary has no concurrent-connection kind. Port forwarding is sold only with a Dedicated IP; the Dedicated IP price list on the prices page shows '$1.99/month' against a struck-through $4.99 for most locations.
binding_note: No byte quota is published and the vendor states unlimited data on paid plans; the connection count and the dedicated-IP requirement for port forwarding are stated limits that the vocabulary cannot rank against a byte or rate quota.

identity_cost.detail: The vendor's page says 'The signup only requires your email.' The trial states no credit card is required. Paid plans are bought against that account; the payment methods are not read on the pages captured.

reliability_note: The setup page and prices page were served with an ad-blocker notice and a sale banner; page content is complete in the capture, but the credentials and config files are behind a login and were not read.
confidence_note: Documented: price, trial, protocol list, SOCKS5, port forwarding and BitTorrent lines are quoted from the vendor's own pages. Nothing was connected through the service, and the config files behind the login were not read, so transport and obfuscation details for ShadowSocks and AmneziaWG are unverified.
price_per_tb_month: USD 39.99 billed annually for the 1-year plan; a subscription price, not a per-TB price
